# Majeed syndrome (LPIN2): search to phenopackets with the frozen pipeline (`pv1s-majeed`, 2026-11-15)

*Generated by `analysis/majeed/report.py`. Exploratory: Majeed syndrome is a substitute disease (pre-registration §4.2), not part of the six-disease study; these results are reported on their own and never pooled with the registered runs. Decision log: `DECISIONS.md`, 2026-11-15. All gap candidates are *pending adjudication*.*

## Corpus

- 1319 PubMed records from every search method (log: `data/literature/majeed/search.md`); 131 passed title/abstract screening; 79 had open full text, including copies found by hand; 22 eligible after full-text screening (17 primary reports).
- Run on 24 documents: the eligible PubMed papers plus two eligible records with no PMID (N66, a PReS 2011 abstract; N88, Han 2025). N76 left out as the preprint of Liu 2019 (PMID 31727123).
- Checklist: 20 features from three openly licensed reviews (Ferguson 2021, Wang 2025, Haşlak 2025; `configs/checklists/majeed.json`); one item, warmth or redness over bone or joint, has no HPO term of its scope and is marked unmapped.

## Extraction and gatekeeper

- Span check: 100.0% of spans found verbatim, 0 problems after one repair-only resume (empty label spans in one paper).
- People: 164 rows, 158 identities after 6 merges; 141 with an LPIN2 variant row.
- Gatekeeper v4 on 5161 model claims: supported 4971, partially supported 155, unsupported 35. Unsupported or not found 0.7% (35/5161; 95% CI 0.5–0.9); not fully supported 3.7% (190/5161; 95% CI 3.2–4.2). These are gatekeeper rates, not audited error rates (no human audit).
- Four gatekeeper chunks (Ferguson 2021 ×3, Sharma 2013) were judged again by fresh helpers because the first helpers assigned verdicts with a script (one was refused by the permission check); the first files are kept under `gatekeeper_v4_set_aside/` (local). The re-judgement changed verdicts: e.g. 14 'spine involvement excluded' claims became partially supported because whole-body MRI was not done in most patients.

## Stage 4 and phenopackets

- Variants: 62 distinct descriptions; 67.7% normalized or corrected by VariantValidator (91.3% of cDNA descriptions) on MANE Select NM_001375808.2. Older papers use NM_014646.2, whose CDS has the same length (2,691 nt).
- HPO: 71.1% of feature rows bound after the model pass (one Sonnet batch of 217 phrases).
- Phenopackets: 158, all schema-valid (158); 100 with an interpretation; 68 variants with a normalized expression and 46 with the original string only; 5 observed/excluded conflicts listed in `phenopacket_build.json`.

## ClinVar concordance (O2; snapshot 2026-11-15, release of Mon, 09 Nov 2026 13:09:17 GMT)

- LPIN2 in ClinVar: 1051 single-gene records, 51 P/LP, 455 VUS.
- Gene correct: 100.0% (141/141; 95% CI 97.3–100.0).
- Overlap (extracted distinct alleles found in ClinVar, tier 1): 50.0% (12/24; 95% CI 31.4–68.6).
- HGVS recall against the ClinVar variant–citation pairs of corpus papers: tier 1 6.6% (5/76; 95% CI 2.8–14.5); tiers 1+2 10.5% (8/76; 95% CI 5.4–19.4). Low mainly because ClinVar cites some corpus papers (e.g. Ferguson 2005) for variants those papers do not report (`o2_recall_misses.csv`).
- Classification agreement where the authors state one: 62.5% (5/8; 95% CI 30.6–86.3). Condition names the disease: 100.0% (19/19; 95% CI 83.2–100.0).
- OMIM not checked (the frozen OMIM pages cover only the six diseases).

## Licences and what is public (D-51)

- 18 documents are openly licensed; 6 are not (15994876, 23087183, 23917160, 27252506, 33993107, N66). Their extraction outputs, and the 27 phenopackets that quote them, are kept out of the repository; 131 phenopackets and the open documents' per-paper and gatekeeper files are committed (`analysis/majeed/d51_public_files.json`).

## Spend (helper tokens; estimates, not billing figures)

- Pipeline run: about $92 (extraction $38, gatekeeper $41 including re-judgements, checklist and map $5, HPO binding $1, runbook $7); ceiling was $120. Search screening: about $22. Source: `analysis/majeed/helper_costs.json`.

## Limits

- No human audit of extraction or screening yet; gatekeeper agreement is not accuracy.
- 52 corpus papers have no open copy, including the founding reports (Majeed 1989 and 2001, Al-Mosawi 2007) and several cohorts; the Chavan 2021 literature table (Supplementary Table 3) was not available.
- Several patients appear in more than one paper (reviews re-tabulating case reports); deduplication merged only what the merge policy could support, so identity counts are upper bounds.
